sections.name: RoutineCard (part 2)
sections.title: Checklist items and friction tips
sections.what: Lists each item with a circle or tick, its title and its minutes. Clicking an item flips its done state. A lightbulb appears only when the item has a tip, and it opens a banner with that tip.
sections.why: Likely reason: the lightbulb keeps extra advice out of sight until the user asks for it.
sections.watch_out: Only one tip shows at a time, so opening another tip closes the first.

summary: One routine card showing a checklist of daily steps, a progress bar, and optional friction tips.
purpose: Lets the user tick off a daily routine and see how much of it is done.
why: Likely reason: routines are meant to be run as a set, so a checklist with progress keeps the user on track.
how: Counts completed items and works out a percent. Shows a header with the title, tagline and an EXECUTED TODAY badge when finished. Clicking an item toggles its done state. A lightbulb button on an item opens a tip below the list.
inputs: A routine record with its title, tagline, colour, items, durations and optional tips, plus clicks on items and tip buttons.
outputs: Updated item completion in the store, and tip text shown on screen.
risks: Only one tip is open at a time. The percent is rounded, so the displayed total can look one step off. A reset function is imported but not used in this file.
debug: If progress does not move, check the toggle function and the item ids. If the badge is wrong, check the executed-today flag. If a tip is blank, check the tip field on that item.
